questions.q: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) recently hiked the interest rates on 'Green Deposits' to encourage which of the following?
questions.explain: The RBI is really pushing for a greener economy. By making Green Deposits more attractive, they're nudging banks to use that money specifically for projects that help the environment—like renewable energy plants or electric vehicle infrastructure.
